name: Caption-style grid, one tap
looks: A headline lands naming a large number of styles and 'one tap.' Six small preview cards of the same clip pop into a grid beneath it, each captioned in a different visual style (a plain classic line, a highlighted box, a bold pop colour, a neon glow, a marker-stroke underline, a boxed chip), each card's caption already mid-sentence.
build: list-stack-reveal for the headline; variant-stack-reveal for the six-card grid, seeded offsets settling square in two rows of three, each card's own caption style baked into its own small karaoke-caption-sync pass rather than shared code.
sound: A tick per headline line and a soft cluster of pops as the six cards land.
prompt: Show stylistic range at a glance: pop in a small grid of preview cards of the same clip, each captioned in a visibly different style, so the viewer compares looks side by side instead of cycling through them one at a time.
